title: Long-Session Memory Keeper
subtitle: Keeps a long session within its memory budget by shrinking older tool output in stages and leaving a pointer that brings the full text back on request.
lede: Keeps a long session within its memory budget by shrinking older tool output in stages and leaving a pointer that brings the full text back on request. Before the session's memory is condensed, it writes a reflection of where things stand and puts that reflection back at the start of the resumed session.
who: A team running long AI-assisted working sessions
author: Corey James
